Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.base

module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.base
Common persistence tooling infrastructure, configuration options, and utilities for Hibernate.

This module provides shared baseline contracts and utility methods used across version-specific Hibernate persistence tooling providers (such as Hibernate 5 and Hibernate ORM 6). It encapsulates shared enhancer option configuration and class loading helpers, while transitively exposing the core persistence tools API.

Exported Packages

  • hibernate.base.persistence.tools – Common bytecode enhancement options and utility classes for Hibernate tool implementations.
